display.purpose: Every H1/H2 on the page. One weight only (400), already maximal — never set smaller than the section-title scale.

body.purpose: All prose. Kept plain so the display face stays the page's one loud voice.

hand.purpose: Short tape labels only — 'Layout', 'Structure', 'yours to paint'. Never a full sentence or body copy.

label.purpose: The mono 'system voice': pills, captions, stamp text. Always uppercase, always tracked.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Paired with translateY(-2px) rotate(-0.4deg) on button hover.

shadows.name: tape-rest
shadows.purpose: Tape strip at rest — a soft, tight lift.

shadows.name: tape-peeled
shadows.purpose: Tape strip lifted/hovered — a larger, softer lift paired with rotate+translate+scale(1.06).

motion.name: reveal-settle
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered position-settle (translateY(10px) -> none). Opacity is never gated — content is always visible by default; this transition only nudges position.

motion.name: tape-lift
motion.purpose: The tape strip's peel interaction on hover/press/aria-pressed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's only filled button colour — sign-paint yellow, ink text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8b023; border: 1px solid #18130d; color: #18130d; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0bd35; transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-0.4deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(24,19,13,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6392b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Same shape and border as primary; card-white fill instead of yellow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fffdf6; border: 1px solid #18130d; color: #18130d; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-0.4deg); box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(24,19,13,0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6392b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tape Strip
components.description: The signature component: a real <button>, torn-edge clip-path, per-instance rotation, lifts on hover/press to reveal a permanent 'protected' stamp underneath that never changes.
components.css: .ds-tape { position: relative; border: 0; padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0c34a 0%, #e8b023 55%, #d19c17 100%); clip-path: polygon(0% 17%, 8% 7%, 15% 14%, 23% 9%, 31% 14%, 38% 9%, 46% 15%, 54% 6%, 62% 18%, 69% 4%, 77% 20%, 85% 3%, 92% 20%, 100% 4%, 100% 91%, 92% 86%, 85% 92%, 77% 84%, 69% 95%, 62% 81%, 54% 97%, 46% 80%, 38% 97%, 31% 81%, 23% 95%, 15% 84%, 8% 92%, 0% 86%); transform: rotate(-3deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 8px rgba(24,19,13,0.32)); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), filter 0.4s ease; } .ds-tape:hover, .ds-tape[aria-pressed="true"] { transform: rotate(-12deg) translate(6px, -20px) scale(1.06); filter: drop-shadow(0 26px 22px rgba(24,19,13,0.4)); } .ds-tape-label { font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #6b4a00; }

components.name: Editable-Wash Card
components.description: A card marking content as client-paintable: yellow-tinted wash, dashed (not solid) outline signalling 'provisional/paintable'.
components.html:
exposed — paint it

The words
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.75rem; } .ds-card-edit { background: color-mix(in srgb, #e8b023 14%, #fffdf6); outline: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, #6b4a00 45%, transparent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #6b4a00; display: block; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }

components.name: Locked Card
components.description: A card marking content as structurally off-limits: solid ink ground, small red hazard-stripe corner marks.
components.css: .ds-card-lock { background: #211a12; color: rgba(244,239,228,0.92); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.75rem; position: relative; } .ds-card-lock-label { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(244,239,228,0.6); display: block; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; } .ds-card-lock::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -8px; left: -8px; width: 46px; height: 22px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #b6392b 0 6px, #f4efe4 6px 12px); transform: rotate(-8deg); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Canvas-filled (not white) so fields read as part of the paper, not a separate UI layer.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #c9b98d; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; background: #f4efe4; color: #18130d; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #786646; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6392b; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Castor's whole pitch is that the owner decides exactly what a client may touch, and the system enforces the line no matter how hard someone pulls at it. Rather than argue this in copy over a dashboard screenshot — the category default — the page acts it out: a mocked homepage sits behind real masking tape, sign-paint yellow washes over the words and pictures a client may repaint, and the tape strips genuinely lift on hover or tap, revealing a permanent 'PROTECTED' stamp underneath rather than an unlocked surface. The interaction is the proof, not a decoration next to it. The palette is warm and workshop-grounded — raw canvas, near-black ink, one signal red — never the near-black-plus-neon-accent SaaS default, and never cream-plus-serif. Type pairs a heavy stencilled slab display face with a plain workhorse body face and a hand-lettered face reserved for short tape labels only; the hand face never carries a sentence. Confirmed visual rejections: software chrome of any kind (no browser bar, no dashboard mockup, no window traffic-lights), and section-numbering used to imply order that doesn't exist.
keyCharacteristics: Real masking tape, not a metaphor spoken about — a working peel interaction with a permanent protected state underneath
Warm canvas ground, ink-dark text, one yellow editable signal, one red accent used sparingly
A heavy slab display face, a hand-lettered face rationed to short labels, a plain body face
Motion always starts from a fully visible, legible default — position can settle in, content is never hidden behind a trigger
No kickers, no eyebrows, no numbering without real sequence, no hard-offset neobrutalist shadows — this world's depth is soft and paper-lifted, not blocky

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Sign-paint yellow means 'editable' everywhere on the page — a tape strip, a text highlight, a button, a pill. It never appears as plain decoration; if you reach for yellow, you are marking something a client can touch.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No heading on this page is preceded by an eyebrow, kicker, or overline label. This was corrected during finish review — the page originally opened five section headings with a mono kicker; all five were removed and the informational ones were folded into the following sentence instead. Do not reintroduce the pattern to a new section.

rules.name: The Blur-Always Rule
rules.body: Every shadow on this page has a blur radius greater than zero. A hard offset shadow (Npx Npx 0 0) is a neobrutalist costume this world never chose; if a new component wants depth, give it a soft lift, not a block double.

dos: Do keep sign-paint yellow as the only colour that means 'editable' — do not introduce a second 'this is touchable' colour.
Do give every shadow a blur radius (see The Blur-Always Rule).
Do let headings stand alone — no kicker, eyebrow, or overline label above any heading (see The No-Kicker Rule).
Do default every piece of content to visible; motion may settle a position in, but must never gate visibility behind a scroll trigger or any other JS event.
Do reserve the Caveat hand face for short tape labels; never set body copy or a full sentence in it.
Do number a sequence only when the order itself carries information the reader needs (the three-step 'how it works' flow qualifies; a feature grid of unordered capabilities does not).
donts: Don't add a dashboard-screenshot or browser-chrome hero — the whole point of this world is that it never shows software chrome, only the tape and the mocked page underneath it.
Don't use a flat, zero-blur offset shadow (Npx Npx 0 0) anywhere on this page; it is a neobrutalist costume this world does not wear.

Don't fake a colored border-left/border-right via an inset box-shadow on cards or list rows — this pattern was present on the 'live' version row and the form's success state in an earlier draft and was removed at finish review.
Don't apply any token in this file to components/editor/ or components/sections/ (the product UI) — that surface's plain Tailwind/slate system is separate and this file does not govern it.
